title: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Grate zucchini and a small beetroot. Salt them and leave to drain.
Gently fry a diced brown onion, minced ginger and a chopped chilli.
When the onion is soft, add cumin, smoked paprika and tomato paste.
Fry for just a minute, then stir in the red lentils to coat them.
Pour in two cups of chicken stock. Add chopped mushrooms if you like.
Simmer for fifteen minutes, or until the lentils are cooked through.
Squeeze the water from the drained zucchini and beetroot mix.
Mix in diced red onion, chopped herbs, salt and plenty of pepper.
Add chickpea flour a spoon at a time until it just holds together.
Stir chopped rocket into the soup and simmer a few minutes longer.
Fry little fritters in a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Add lemon juice to the soup. Serve with the fritters and yoghurt.
